title: DOW-UAP-PR051, "Syrian UAP instant acceleration"
what_is_it: An infrared video recorded by a U.S. military sensor platform, uploaded to a classified network and released as part of the PURSUE collection in response to a congressional records request.
interpretation_warnings: The video was digitally altered before upload to the classified network — the nature and extent of alteration is not specified.
The materials lack a substantiated chain of custody, meaning provenance cannot be independently verified.
AARO uses qualifying language ('likely derived from') indicating the sensor platform attribution is not confirmed.
The CSV description text is truncated at '00:20-00:21: The sensor stops t' — the full video description is incomplete.
The auto-transcribed audio contains no intelligible content (repeated 'You' artifacts), providing no additional context.
The uploader-defined title ('Syrian UAP instant acceleration') was chosen by whoever uploaded the video and does not represent an official assessment.

verifiable_claims.claim: The video likely originated from an infrared sensor on a U.S. military platform in the CENTCOM AOR in 2021
verifiable_claims.source_quote: likely derived from an infrared sensor aboard a U.S. military platform operating within the United States Central Command area of responsibility in 2021
